likelyQuestions: Explain the general structure of optimization algorithms and discuss two real-world engineering applications.
Formulate a complete integer programming model for a facility location problem with specific capacity and cost constraints.
Classify optimization problems based on the nature of governing equations, providing relevant engineering examples for each category.
Define the feasible region in linear programming and explain the mathematical role of constraints using a formulated example.
Solve a maximization linear programming problem with two decision variables using the graphical method, and discuss its limitations compared to the simplex method.
Discuss the termination criteria of the Simplex method and explain how it detects unbounded solutions.
Describe the step-by-step application of Genetic Algorithms to the Knapsack problem, detailing encoding, fitness evaluation, and genetic operators.
Design an Ant Colony Optimization algorithm for the Traveling Salesperson Problem, explaining the pheromone update rules and solution construction strategies.
Formulate a decision tree for a manufacturing expansion problem involving multiple demand states and calculate the expected monetary value for each course of action.
Determine the optimal decision for a given payoff matrix using Maximin, Maximax, Minimax Regret, Equal Probability, and Hurwicz criteria.
